title: Postcard template : picture box, message lines, address lines
subject: English
source: Written for english/y1 lesson 107 (Postcard template (pupil PDF): picture box, message lines, address lines)
intro: Lesson 107: Writing a postcard from a sunny place. Listen, look, then do the tasks with a grown-up.

parts.text: It is hot and sunny here. (weather)
I saw a camel by the huge dunes. (news)
I feel happy because the sky is so blue. (feeling)

panels.title: Draw your picture
points: Draw the place: sky, sun, land or sea

keywords.def: a card with a picture on one side and a short message on the other
the words we write to someone
how we end: Love from, From
what the sky and air are like each day

questions.a: For example: It is hot and sunny.

questions.q: Core: write a postcard: Dear, two sentences of news, Love from
questions.a: A postcard with Dear, two news sentences and a sign off

questions.q: Extend: add how you feel using because
questions.a: For example: I feel happy because the sky is blue.

questions.q: Stretch: draw the picture side of your postcard
questions.a: A labelled picture of the place

questions.q: How do we end a postcard?
questions.a: B) Love from Musa. Love from (or From) and your name goes at the end. Dear goes at the start.

questions.q: Join: It is hot. I feel happy.
questions.a: It is hot and I feel happy.
